mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cabinet_transaction (transaction_id, card_uid, room_number) VALUES (#{transactionId}, #{cardUid}, #{roomNumber}) ON CONFLICT (transaction_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO cabinet_history ( transaction_id, cabinet_id, event_type, triggered_by, step ) VALUES ( #{transactionId}, #{cabinetId}, #{eventType}, #{triggeredBy}, #{step} )
mapper.select: SELECT step, event_type FROM cabinet_history WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT card_uid FROM cabinet_transaction WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT status FROM cabinet WHERE cabinet_id = #{cabinetId} FOR UPDATE
